<?php

class ConnectionPool {
    private array $connections = [];
    private array $connectionState = [];
    private int $maxConnections = 10;
    private int $activeCount = 0;

    public function acquire(): ?PDO {
        foreach ($this->connections as $id => $conn) {
            if ($this->connectionState[$id] === 'idle') {
                $this->connectionState[$id] = 'active';
                $this->activeCount++;
                return $conn;
            }
        }
        if (count($this->connections) < $this->maxConnections) {
            return $this->createConnection();
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function release(PDO $conn): void {
        $id = spl_object_id($conn);
        if (isset($this->connectionState[$id])) {
            $this->connectionState[$id] = 'idle';
            $this->activeCount--;
        }
    }

    public function evict(PDO $conn): void {
        $id = spl_object_id($conn);
        unset($this->connections[$id]);
        unset($this->connectionState[$id]);
        $this->activeCount--;
    }

    private function createConnection(): PDO {
        $dsn = getenv('DB_DSN') ?: 'mysql:host=localhost;dbname=payments';
        $conn = new PDO($dsn, getenv('DB_USER') ?: 'root', getenv('DB_PASS') ?: '');
        $conn->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
        $id = spl_object_id($conn);
        $this->connections[$id] = $conn;
        $this->connectionState[$id] = 'active';
        $this->activeCount++;
        return $conn;
    }
}

class TransactionContext {
    private ?PDO $connection;
    private bool $committed = false;
    private bool $rolledBack = false;

    public function __construct(?PDO $connection) {
        $this->connection = $connection;
    }

    public function getConnection(): ?PDO {
        return $this->connection;
    }

    public function begin(): bool {
        if ($this->connection === null) {
            return false;
        }
        return $this->connection->beginTransaction();
    }

    public function commit(): bool {
        if ($this->connection === null) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->committed = true;
        return $this->connection->commit();
    }

    public function rollback(): bool {
        if ($this->connection === null) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->rolledBack = true;
        return $this->connection->rollBack();
    }

    public function isFinalized(): bool {
        return $this->committed || $this->rolledBack;
    }

    public function detach(): void {
        $this->connection = null;
    }
}

class PaymentProcessor {
    private ConnectionPool $pool;
    private array $pendingContexts = [];

    public function __construct(ConnectionPool $pool) {
        $this->pool = $pool;
    }

    public function processPayment(array $paymentData): array {
        $validated = $this->validatePayment($paymentData);
        if (!$validated['valid']) {
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => $validated['error']];
        }

        $context = $this->beginTransaction();
        $this->pendingContexts[] = $context;

        try {
            $result = $this->executePayment($context, $validated['data']);
            if ($result['success']) {
                $this->finalizeTransaction($context, true);
            } else {
                $this->finalizeTransaction($context, false);
            }
            return $result;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->finalizeTransaction($context, false);
            return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Processing failed'];
        }
    }

    private function beginTransaction(): TransactionContext {
        $conn = $this->pool->acquire();
        $context = new TransactionContext($conn);
        $context->begin();
        return $context;
    }

    private function executePayment(TransactionContext $context, array $data): array {
        $conn = $context->getConnection();
        
        $idempotencyKey = $data['idempotency_key'];
        $existing = $this->checkIdempotency($conn, $idempotencyKey);
        if ($existing !== null) {
            return $existing;
        }

        $stmt = $conn->prepare(
            'INSERT INTO payments (merchant_id, amount, currency, status, idempotency_key) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
        );
        $stmt->execute([
            $data['merchant_id'],
            $data['amount'],
            $data['currency'],
            'pending',
            $idempotencyKey
        ]);

        $paymentId = $conn->lastInsertId();

        $gatewayResult = $this->callGateway($data);
        
        if ($gatewayResult['approved']) {
            $updateStmt = $conn->prepare('UPDATE payments SET status = ? WHERE id = ?');
            $updateStmt->execute(['completed', $paymentId]);
            return ['success' => true, 'payment_id' => $paymentId];
        }

        return ['success' => false, 'error' => 'Payment declined'];
    }

    private function checkIdempotency(?PDO $conn, string $key): ?array {
        if ($conn === null) {
            return null;
        }
        $stmt = $conn->prepare('SELECT id, status FROM payments WHERE idempotency_key = ?');
        $stmt->execute([$key]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if ($row) {
            return ['success' => true, 'payment_id' => $row['id'], 'cached' => true];
        }
        return null;
    }

    private function finalizeTransaction(TransactionContext $context, bool $commit): void {
        if ($context->isFinalized()) {
            return;
        }
        
        $conn = $context->getConnection();
        
        if ($commit) {
            $context->commit();
        } else {
            $context->rollback();
        }

        $context->detach();
        
        if ($conn !== null) {
            $this->pool->release($conn);
        }
    }

    private function validatePayment(array $data): array {
        $required = ['merchant_id', 'amount', 'currency', 'idempotency_key'];
        foreach ($required as $field) {
            if (!isset($data[$field]) || empty($data[$field])) {
                return ['valid' => false, 'error' => "Missing field: $field"];
            }
        }
        if (!is_numeric($data['amount']) || $data['amount'] <= 0) {
            return ['valid' => false, 'error' => 'Invalid amount'];
        }
        if (!in_array($data['currency'], ['USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'], true)) {
            return ['valid' => false, 'error' => 'Unsupported currency'];
        }
        return ['valid' => true, 'data' => $data];
    }

    private function callGateway(array $data): array {
        // Simulated gateway call
        return ['approved' => $data['amount'] < 10000];
    }

    public function processBatchWithRetry(array $payments): array {
        $results = [];
        foreach ($payments as $payment) {
            $result = $this->processPayment($payment);
            if (!$result['success'] && isset($result['error']) && $result['error'] === 'Processing failed') {
                // Retry once on transient failure
                $this->cleanupStaleContexts();
                $result = $this->processPayment($payment);
            }
            $results[] = $result;
        }
        return $results;
    }

    private function cleanupStaleContexts(): void {
        foreach ($this->pendingContexts as $idx => $context) {
            if ($context->isFinalized()) {
                unset($this->pendingContexts[$idx]);
            } else {
                // Force cleanup of non-finalized contexts
                $conn = $context->getConnection();
                $context->rollback();
                $context->detach();
                // Connection evicted rather than released after forced rollback
                if ($conn !== null) {
                    $this->pool->evict($conn);
                }
                unset($this->pendingContexts[$idx]);
            }
        }
    }
}
